Your holdings: SOXL (-62.82%), MUU (-35.44%), and SMCI (-24.93%) are your top concerns. These leveraged ETFs and chip names are deep in the red, and your margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on broader tech sentiment, especially around cloud names, following Elon Musk's comments and the general 'dot-com survivor' warning.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech positions.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (-62.82%) or adjusting its stop from 200 to a more realistic level below current price (83.56) to manage extreme downside risk.
Review MUU (-35.44%) and SMCI (-24.93%); their stops are above current prices, suggesting a potential trim or re-evaluation of your exit strategy.
Monitor QQQI (-6.21%) closely as its stop (52) is just below the current price (52.59); be ready to act if it breaks.
